study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Meijer et al., Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Toward Understanding Autism Heterogeneity: Identifying Clinical Subgroups and Neuroanatomical Deviations

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Combine data-driven clinical subgrouping with normative modeling of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes to test whether reducing clinical heterogeneity increases neuroanatomical homogeneity and improves ASD classification.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The study explicitly states that both ABIDE I and ABIDE II repositories were combined for all analyses.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: We combined the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) repositories I ... and II ... for all the analyses conducted in the present study.

rci2_hc_n.reason: The main paper and supplementary materials clearly state the final number of non-autistic individuals (NAI), which are the healthy controls (HC), included in the normative modeling analysis after all exclusion criteria were applied. The primary analysis was conducted on males only.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 NAI between 5 and 64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis (see Table 1).

rci4_hc_sex.reason: The paper states that for the primary analyses, only males were included due to the limited sample size of females. The final sample for normative modeling consisted of 744 NAI, all of whom were male.
rci4_hc_sex.supporting_text: For primary analyses, we excluded females due to scarce availability...primary analyses were conducted in males only due to limited sample size of females (N autism = 130, N NAI = 280).

rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: We processed the T1-weighted images from the ABIDE datasets using the FreeSurfer software (Version 7.3.2).

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: Site included as covariate in warped Bayesian Linear Regression model; sites with <10 individuals per diagnostic group excluded; sites with same/highly similar imaging acquisition protocols merged across ABIDE I and II
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: We included age, site, FIQ, and quality measures (i.e., the Euler number) as covariates and additional intracranial volume for subcortical volumes... sites with less than 10 individuals per diagnostic group (Bayer et al., 2022; Gaiser et al., 2023) (N autism = 69, N NAI = 15)... Sites with same/highly similar imaging acquisition protocols (as outlined and recommended on the website) were merged across ABIDE I and ABIDE II into one single site to increase sample sizes per site (i.e., KKI and ABIDEII-KKI; NYU and ABIDEII-NYU_1; SDSU and ABIDEII-SDSU; and UCLA_1 and ABIDEII-UCLA_1).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Two clinical subgroups primarily differing in RRBs showed increased homogeneity in localized neuroanatomical deviations (cerebellar volume increases in high-RRB; decreased CT in postcentral/fusiform in low-RRB), but classifier performance did not improve, indicating substantial residual heterogeneity.
